bills.summary: Lets spending on federal university hospitals count toward the constitutional minimum for health.
Lets the Union postpone debts and cut interest for states and cities hit by declared calamities.
Declares the Mato Grosso do Sul Pantanal a national heritage in the Constitution.
Says the service tax (ISS) on hoisting and towing services is due where the work is done.
Creates the Mover green mobility and innovation programme with local-content rules.
Creates the Propag programme to renegotiate states' debts with the Union.
Changes sanctions on parties that missed gender and race funding quotas, including debt refinancing and amnesty.
Regulates the tax reform: creates IBS, CBS and the Selective Tax.
Changes rules for insurance cooperatives and sanctioning procedure at the insurance regulator.
Lets states and municipalities carry over unspent education funds from past years.
Sets rules for proposing and executing parliamentary budget amendments.
Regulates special retirement for community health agents and anti-epidemic agents.
Creates the IBS management committee and rules for the new consumption tax.
Requests urgent handling of a bill in the Senate.
Creates the Propag programme to renegotiate states' debts with the Union.
Regulates students' use of personal electronic devices in schools.
Tightens the fiscal framework (LC 200) with extra spending-control measures.
Changes budget and education-funding rules in the Constitution as part of the 2024 spending-cut package.
Changes agricultural, social-assistance and Bolsa Família rules as part of the 2024 spending-cut package.
Sets a deadline to settle unprocessed carry-over budget commitments, including parliamentary amendments.
Changes how the Social Fund can be used to address socioeconomic challenges.
Creates the 'Acredita Exportação' programme and widens Simples Nacional benefits for exporters.
Extends the deadline to settle unprocessed carry-over budget commitments, including parliamentary amendments.
Gives states and municipalities more time to move balances in their health funds.
Exempts federal regulatory agencies' spending from budget freezes.
Fixes the number of federal deputies and how seats are distributed among states.
Creates a national policy supporting professional road-freight transport.
Changes electricity-sector laws through a provisional measure.
Creates commissioned functions and judicial-police posts at the Supreme Federal Court.
Sets conditions and limits for tax incentives for sport.
Limits payment of court-ordered debts by states and municipalities and opens a new instalment plan.
Sets exceptional spending and tax-waiver procedures to cushion the effects of US tariffs on Brazilian exports.
Authorises retroactive seniority and leave-bonus payments to public servants in calamity-hit governments.
Directs prison-fund money to training prison staff and police officers.
Creates the National Education System (SNE).
Excludes strategic defence projects from fiscal targets and spending freezes.
Excludes temporary education and health spending from the fiscal-framework limits.
Creates special retirement and regularises the status of community health agents.
Lets a teacher hold a second paid public position.
Sets general rules for resolving tax disputes by agreement.
Lets fire-department pre-hospital rescue services receive health-budget amendments.
Creates the legal framework against organised crime.
Changes penal-execution rules and the Penal Code.
Cuts federal tax and financial incentives and makes third parties liable for betting taxes.
Adjusts a provision of Complementary Law 224/2025.
Cuts PIS/Cofins rates for the chemical and petrochemical industry.
Reallocates public-security powers between the Union, states and municipalities.
Sets general rules for splitting municipalities.
Sets rules on tax benefits and mandatory spending for 2026.
Gives the oil regulator ANP access to tax information of regulated firms.
Sets conditions for an ISS tax exemption for the 2027 Women's World Cup.
Cuts the maximum working week and gives two paid rest days, with no pay cut.
Sets rules for tax waivers to soften an international energy-price shock.
Bars spending freezes on the telecommunications universalisation fund.
Adds a data-centre tax regime and other programmes to a 2026 complementary law.
Raises the revenue and staff limits for micro-entrepreneurs (MEI) and forgives some federal debts.
Changes the fiscal framework to give the Executive new fiscal-management tools.
